Migration ships a TimescaleDB hypertable + RLS policy at production scale, but **zero application code reads or writes it** — no entity, no service, no rollup job, no reconciliation cron, no API. The hypertable is a phantom asset that will accumulate retention pressure on a TimescaleDB chunk worker without ever serving a query.\n21\t\n22\tThree fundamental control loops are unimplemented end-to-end:\n23\t\n24\t1. **Emit → Rollup**: Anthropic SDK token consumption at `agent-runner.service.ts:204-207` updates only `TokenBudget` (Redis monthly counter); no Prometheus emission, no NATS event, no insert into `tenant_cost_rollup`. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01ScrGZes6DwR8Mr3Jm4VTn9","type":"tool_result","content":"195\t- Agent operating spec: *Forbidden label set on general metrics: `tenant_id` as a raw label (cardinality explosion). Use a separate cost-dedicated metric family `tenant_cost_*` that CAN carry `tenant_id` label but is scraped less frequently + routed to push-gateway + long-term storage.* — no separate family exists; the unsafe label sits on the general histogram.\n196\t- ADR-011 / W1 audit — tenant-id provenance must be JWT-anchored, not header-defaulted.\n197\t\n198\t**Proposed fix direction (joint with sibling findings)**\n199\t- Tier-1 — split metric families: keep general HTTP metrics WITHOUT `tenant` label; introduce `tenant_cost_*{tenant_id, ...}` family scraped at 60s push-gateway only, with explicit cardinality budget. JWT-bind tenantId for both families.\n200\t- Tier-2 — pipe rollup input from the cost-dedicated family alone; general metrics aggregate by `service` only.\n201\t- Tier-3 — extend the existing `no-high-cardinality-metric-label` ESLint rule (referenced in `orchestrator-metrics.ts:16`) to enforce: (a) the `tenant` label appears only on metric names matching `^tenant_cost_*`; (b) header fallback for tenantId on metrics is forbidden — only JWT claim or trusted internal-service identity.\n202\t- Joint resolution with `PLAT-CRITICAL-001` and `MT-CRITICAL-004` is mandatory: solving cardinality without preserving cost-rollup attribution = our pipeline breaks; preserving the unsafe label keeps the DoS open.\n203\t\n204\t**Affected surface (ripple set)**\n205\t- `libs/backend-common/src/metrics/metrics.service.ts` — drop `tenant` from general metrics\n206\t- `libs/backend-common/src/metrics/metrics.middleware.ts` — remove header fallback path\n207\t- `libs/backend-common/src/metrics/cost-metrics.ts` (new)\n208\t- `infrastructure/monitoring/prometheus/cost-metrics.yml` (new — referenced in agent spec, currently missing)\n209\t- ESLint custom rule + invariant test\n210\t- 5 services with `labelNames: [..., 'tenant']`: `messaging-metrics.service.ts`, `farm-domain-metrics.service.ts`, `gateway-api/farm.gateway.ts` — same audit, ripple.\n211\t\n212\t**Expected closer**\n213\t- observability-expert primary on cardinality; this agent + multi-tenant-saas-expert + auth-security-expert co-CATCHERs (provenance + fix path). Architectural-arbiter ruling required because ≥3 agents own slices.\n214\t\n215\t---\n216\t\n217\t#### TENANTCOST-HIGH-004 — `cost_catalog` price table absent — rollup migration's \"tokens × model_price\" formula is uncomputable\n218\t\n219\t**Severity:** HIGH\n220\t**Layer:** 2 (data lineage)\n221\t**State:** OPEN\n222\t**Sub-kind:** `ROLLUP_MISS`\n223\t\n224\t**Evidence**\n225\t- Agent operating spec: *Cost conversion: `tokens × model_price` / `bytes × storage_price` / `seconds × compute_price` — prices in a `cost_catalog` table, versioned by `effective_from` (no retroactive price change).*\n226\t- `grep -rE \"cost_catalog|cost.catalog\"` in `apps/`, `libs/` returns zero matches (workspace excluding worktrees).\n227\t- Migration file count check: `apps/observability-service/src/database/migrations/` contains 5 migrations; no `*-AddCostCatalog.ts`.\n228\t- Without the catalog the rollup cannot translate `meter_primary` (tokens) to `cost_usd`, which means even if TENANTCOST-CRITICAL-001 lands a writer, the cost column will be 0 or hard-coded.\n229\t\n230\t**Rule violated**\n231\t- Agent invariant on rollup pipeline (catalog versioning required for retroactive-pricing prevention).\n232\t- Layer-2 data-lineage discipline — pricing is a slowly-changing dimension; without versioning, replays produce wrong totals.\n233\t\n234\t**Proposed fix direction**\n235\t- Tier-1 — `CostCatalog` entity in `apps/observability-service/src/cost-attribution/` with `(category, subcategory, effective_from, effective_to, unit_price_usd, source)` and a constraint that current-prices are unique per `(category, subcategory)` and historical rows are immutable.\n236\t- Tier-2 — seed with current Anthropic pricing per `model`, DO compute pricing per droplet size, MinIO storage rate, Stripe webhook event cost, NATS JetStream rate. Seed data ships in a separate migration so the price-curve is a tracked artifact.\n237\t- Tier-3 — invariant test asserts every `cost_category` enum value has at least one current `effective_to IS NULL` catalog row.\n238\t\n239\t**Affected surface (ripple set)**\n240\t- `apps/observability-service/src/cost-attribution/cost-catalog/{entity,seed,service}.ts` (new)\n241\t- `apps/observability-service/src/database/migrations/180600XXXXXXX-AddCostCatalog.ts` (new)\n242\t- ADR amendment (the agent spec is the only doc; migrating to ADR keeps pricing decisions auditable).\n243\t\n244\t**Expected closer**\n245\t- data-expert primary (catalog table is data-design); this agent CATCHER on rollup-formula correctness.\n246\t\n247\t---\n248\t\n249\t#### TENANTCOST-HIGH-005 — Plan-tier margin SLO and alert wiring entirely undefined\n250\t\n251\t**Severity:** HIGH\n252\t**Layer:** 3 (ADR-016 SLO discipline) + 4 (documented in agent spec only)\n253\t**State:** OPEN\n254\t**Sub-kind:** `MARGIN_BREACH`\n255\t\n256\t**Evidence**\n257\t- `infrastructure/monitoring/prometheus/alerts/slo-alerts.yml` exists (per `find` output) but contains NO rule keyed on `tenant_cost_*`, plan-tier, or margin %.\n258\t- Agent operating spec defines the SLO grid (Starter ≥70%, Professional ≥60%, Enterprise ≥50%) — implementation: zero.
